PATTERN: Claude Code pre-tool-use hook uses native HTTP blocking
COMPONENTS:
- Claude Code POSTs to /api/hooks/pre-tool-use
- HTTP connection stays open (Claude Code blocks waiting for response)
- API route creates a Promise and broadcasts approval request via WebSocket to browser
- User clicks approve/deny in UI → browser sends decision over WebSocket
- WebSocket handler resolves the Promise
- API route responds to Claude Code with decision JSON
- Claude Code was blocking on HTTP response the whole time
WHY: HTTP is naturally blocking — no polling needed, just await the Promise
GOTCHA: Timeout management critical — set 30s on hook config, auto-deny at 25s in code to always respond before Claude Code gives up
